title: 第13章 出手连杀七人第14章 神秘高手
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 李牧火晋升练气三层的事情，引得坊内众人一阵欣慰。
但众人也没太当回事，毕竟这都已经第五个年头了，才刚刚晋升练气三层，这速度已经慢的令人有些匪夷所思了。
要知道，林越半年前便已达到练气七层，而今正在冲击练气八层。
陈功这一年来，憋着一股劲，修行速度竟然提了上来，数日前便已突破到了练气五层。
倒是钱朵朵，修行不紧不慢的，目前只有练气四层。
片刻后。
炼器房内。
李牧火和吴道身前摆着一块精铁，以及一小块银色矿材，那是铁精，是铁矿的精华部分，比精铁还要高出一个级别。
只听吴道开口：“法器和凡器最大的区别，是灵气的通过性。意思是，一名修士能在瞬息间，灌注多少灵气进这件法器。能灌注的灵气越多，意味着法器的品质越好。比如下品法器，通过性高的必然比通过性低的强。而且，通过性高的，在一定程度上可与普通的中品法器抗衡，现在为师教你如何锻造武器通性……”
吴道讲的很透，从烧火控火开始，到灵气化火的手法，再到以灵气辅助熔铸熟铁的教学，让李牧火感觉自己仿佛打开了一个新世界打大门。
“怪不得之前看品器诀看不懂，原来凡器和法器的炼制，是迥然不同的炼制之法。”
因为品器诀书里所品之器的心得与入门，都是从法器开始，不会炼制法器，自然就看不懂，也就无从下手。
且等自己掌握法器炼制，此书应该便能派上用场了。
这天。
在吴道的指导下，李牧火耗时一个月，终于锻造出了人生第一柄法器铁锤，虽然有大半炼制过程是由吴道主导，但这也算是相当大的进步。
从某种意义上，他也算是掌握了真正的炼器之术。
按照这种进度，快则一年，慢则两年，自己必能独自锻造法器。
炼器房内，吴道还在讲述着炼器术的难点，李牧火却忽然心思一动，目光不经意地往外面看了一眼。
他感受到了一股不一样的气息，准确来说是不一样的气血波动正往炼器房走来。
“师父，我回来了。”
却见，竟是三师兄走进了炼器房。
吴道嗯了一声道：“今天怎么这么晚，天都黑了。”
只听三师兄道：“师父，青山镇物资堂换了执事，唤我过去问话，他还让我通知您立刻过去一趟。”
“现在？”
吴道疑惑：“天都已经黑了，什么事非得今天去？明天去不行吗？”
三师兄挠了挠头道：“我也问了，但对方没说，只让您赶紧过去，似乎挺急的。”
吴道眉头微皱，最终还是点了点头：“那行吧！为师这就过去一趟。”
说罢，他便看向李牧火道：“你且自己琢磨琢磨，也不用急，既然已经炼成，后面便会越来越熟练。”
“是，师父。”
只是，李牧火的回答有点儿心不在焉。
不是因为旁人，而是因为三师兄。
content_en:
The fact that Li Muhuo was promoted to the third level of Qi training made everyone in the workshop feel happy.
But everyone didn't take it too seriously. After all, this was already the fifth year, and they had just been promoted to the third level of Qi training. The speed was already incredibly slow.
You know, Lin Yue reached the seventh level of Qi training half a year ago, and is now approaching the eighth level of Qi training.
Over the past year, Chen Gong has been holding back his energy, and his cultivation speed has increased unexpectedly. He has broken through to the fifth level of Qi training a few days ago.
Qian Duoduo, on the other hand, is not hurried in his cultivation. Currently, he is only at the fourth level of Qi training.
After a while.
In the refining room.
In front of Li Muhuo and Wu Dao, there was a piece of fine iron and a small piece of silver mineral material. That was iron essence, the essence of iron ore, which was one level higher than fine iron.
Just listen to Wu Dao say: "The biggest difference between a magic weapon and a mortal weapon is the permeability of spiritual energy. It means how much spiritual energy a monk can pour into the magic weapon in an instant. The more spiritual energy that can be poured into the magic weapon, the better the quality of the magic weapon. For example, low-grade magic weapons with high passability must be stronger than those with low passability. Moreover, those with high passability can compete with ordinary mid-grade magic weapons to a certain extent. Now I will teach you how to forge the permeability of weapons..."
Wu Dao explained very thoroughly, starting from burning and controlling fire, to the method of using spiritual energy to transform fire, and then to the teaching of using spiritual energy to assist in melting and casting wrought iron. Li Muhuo felt as if he had opened the door to a new world.
"No wonder I couldn't understand the art of artifacts before. It turns out that the refining methods of mortal weapons and magic weapons are completely different."
Because the experience and introduction to the tools in the Book of Treasures and Treasures all start with the magic weapon. If you don’t know how to refine the magic weapon, you will naturally not understand it and will not be able to start.
Once you master the refining of magic weapons, this book should come in handy.
This day.
Under Wu Dao's guidance, Li Muhuo spent a month and finally forged his first magical weapon, the iron hammer. Although Wu Dao led most of the refining process, this was considered a considerable progress.
In a sense, he can be regarded as mastering the real art of weapon refining.
According to this progress, it can take as fast as one year or as slow as two years, and I will be able to forge the magic weapon alone.
"Huh?"
In the weapon refining room, Wu Dao was still describing the difficulties of the weapon refining technique, but Li Muhuo suddenly had a thought and glanced outside inadvertently.
He felt a different aura, or to be precise, different fluctuations of energy and blood coming towards the refining room.
"Master, I'm back."
But he saw that it was the third senior brother who walked into the weapon refining room.
Wu Dao hummed and said, "Why are you so late today? It's already dark."
I only heard the third senior brother say: "Master, the deacon of Qingshan Town Materials Hall has changed. He called me over to ask questions. He also asked me to inform you to go there immediately."
"Now?"
Wu Dao was confused: "It's already dark, why do we have to go today? Can't we go tomorrow?"
The third senior brother scratched his head and said: "I also asked, but the other party didn't say anything. He just asked you to hurry over. It seemed to be quite urgent."
Wu Dao frowned slightly, but finally nodded: "That's okay! I'll go over here as a teacher."
After saying that, he looked at Li Muhuo and said, "Just think about it yourself, don't worry, now that you have mastered it, you will become more and more proficient in the future."
"Yes, Master."
However, Li Muhuo's answer was a bit absent-minded.
Not because of others, but because of Third Senior Brother.
title_en: Chapter 13 Killing Seven People in a Row Chapter 14 The Mysterious Master
